questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

57 ∶ 286 ∶∶ 43 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number × 5) + 1 = Second number

57 ∶ 286 → (57 × 5) + 1 = 285 + 1 = 286

Similarly,

43 ∶ ? → (43 × 5) + 1 = 215 + 1 = 216

Hence, the correct answer is** "216".**

questions.question: Among five friends Parineeta, Naira, Rinky, Shristi and Tina, Tina is taller than only three other friends. Rinky is tallest among all friends. Naira is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than Parineeta. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
questions.solution:
Among five friends Parineeta, Naira, Rinky, Shristi and Tina,

1) Tina is taller than only three other friends and Rinky is tallest among all friends.

Rinky > Tina > ____ > ____ > ____ 

2) Naira is taller than only one person and Only two persons are taller than Parineeta.

Rinky > Tina > Parineeta > Naira > Shristi.

∴ Here, 'Shristi' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shristi".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

108 ÷ 6 - 18 + 8 × 9 = 42
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 108 and 18

Given equation is : 108 ÷ 6 - 18 + 8 × 9 = 42

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 18 ÷ 6 - 108 + 8 × 9 = 42

⇒ __**18 ÷ 6**__ - 108 + 8 × 9 = 42

⇒ 3 - 108 + __**8 × 9**__ = 42

⇒ __**3**__ - 108 __**+ 72**__ = 42

⇒ __**75**____** - 108**__ = 42

⇒ - 33 ≠ 42

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 9 and 6

Given equation is : 108 ÷ 6 - 18 + 8 × 9 = 42

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 108 ÷ 9 - 18 + 8 × 6 = 42

⇒ __**108 ÷ 9**__ - 18 + 8 × 6 = 42

⇒ 12 - 18 + __**8 × 6**__ = 42

⇒ __**12**__ - 18 __**+ 48**__ = 42

⇒ __**60**____** - 18**__ = 42

⇒ **42 = 42**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 3) : 18 and 9

Given equation is : 108 ÷ 6 - 18 + 8 × 9 = 42

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 108 ÷ 6 - 9 + 8 × 18 = 42

⇒ __**108 ÷ 6**__ - 9 + 8 × 18 = 42

⇒ 18 - 9 + __**8 × 18**__ = 42

⇒ __**18**__ - 9 __**+ 144**__ = 42

⇒ __**162 - 9**__ = 42

⇒ 153 ≠ 42

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 6 and 8

Given equation is : 108 ÷ 6 - 18 + 8 × 9 = 42

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 108 ÷ 8 - 18 + 6 × 9 = 42

⇒ __**108 ÷ 8**__ - 18 + 6 × 9 = 42

⇒ 13.5 - 18 + __**6 × 9**__ = 42

⇒ __**13.5**__ - 18 __**+ 54**__ = 42

⇒ __**67.5 - 18**__ = 42

⇒ 49.5 ≠ 42

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"9 and 6".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(4, 1, 25)

(8, 5, 169)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number + Second number)² = Third number

 
• (4, 1, 25) → (4 + 1)² = 5² = 25

and

 
• (8, 5, 169) → (8 + 5)² = 13² = 169

Similarly,

 
• **(5, 9, 196) → (5 + 9)² = 14² = 196**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(5, 9, 196)".**

G is third to the right of C. F is third to the right of B. A is not the immediate neighbour of C. E is the immediate neighbour of C. Who is second to the right of A?
questions.solution:
Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) D is second to the right of G and G is third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c9e4434f701602f12e8d6d8c2b96663e763a860b56fc6e3e99cb3e9d496290.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a16acd30e8e885c5043fe0ac501da1ea5bf57774371fb8a9f6012643db1ea3.png] 

Case (ii) :

From Case (i) and case (ii) second to right of 'A' has to be either B or F. In given option there is no 'F'

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
